from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for one company as reported in a 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net income/loss amount (negative for loss)")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    total_revenue_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total revenues amount")
    total_revenue_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. '2025-03'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
